stock.description: Founded in 2006 and based in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, Palinda Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company. The entity, formerly known as Food Idea Holdings Limited until its renaming in October 2020, primarily focuses on the production, sale, and distribution of food items across Hong Kong and Australia. Its diverse operations are categorized into specific segments: Wine Business, Food Products Operations, Investments, and Money Lending. Key activities involve supplying barbequed cuisine and Taiwanese Lou Mei to concession stands within supermarkets, along with the marketing and distribution of wine products and grapes. Additionally, the group participates in securities investments and offers money lending services.
